cues: At the palace Laxminarayan bows low and tells a careful lie: the bull is ill.
It will not get up, eat, move or speak, and its eyes are fixed and still.
Every symptom is true, of a dead bull.
He praises the bull's beauty and courage, a perfect piece of chakari, and suggests a change of climate in the hills, so that it can die conveniently far away.
